paras.text: Step 1: The students work together in pairs. Each student writes down three ways in which he thinks that he and his partner are similar and three ways in which he thinks they are different. He does not show his partner what he has written.
paras.urdu: مرحلہ 1: طلبہ جوڑیوں میں مل کر کام کریں۔ ہر طالب علم تین ایسے پہلو لکھے جن میں اس کے خیال میں وہ اور اس کا ساتھی ایک جیسے ہیں اور تین ایسے جن میں وہ مختلف ہیں۔ وہ اپنے ساتھی کو نہیں دکھاتا کہ اس نے کیا لکھا ہے۔
paras.pashto: ګام 1: زده کوونکي په جوړو کې یوځای کار کوي. هر زده کوونکی درې داسې لارې لیکي چې د هغه په اند هغه او ملګری یې ورته دي او درې داسې چې توپیر لري. هغه خپل ملګري ته نه ښيي چې څه یې لیکلي.

paras.text: Step 2: First, both students tell each other about the similarities and talk about where they were right or wrong, then they talk about the differences.
paras.urdu: مرحلہ 2: پہلے دونوں طلبہ ایک دوسرے کو مماثلتوں کے بارے میں بتائیں اور بات کریں کہ وہ کہاں درست یا غلط تھے، پھر وہ فرق کے بارے میں بات کریں۔
paras.pashto: ګام 2: لومړی دواړه زده کوونکي یو بل ته د ورته والي په اړه ووايي او خبرې وکړي چې چېرته سم یا ناسم وو، بیا د توپیرونو په اړه خبرې وکړي.

paras.text: B. Complete these sentences with an opposite of the verb in BOLD. Use the words from the box. Make sure that you use the correct form of each verb. The first one has been done for you.
paras.urdu: B. ان جملوں کو جلی (BOLD) فعل کے متضاد سے مکمل کریں۔ خانے میں دیے گئے الفاظ استعمال کریں۔ یقینی بنائیں کہ آپ ہر فعل کی درست شکل استعمال کریں۔ پہلا آپ کے لیے حل کر دیا گیا ہے۔
paras.pashto: B. دا جملې په تکړه (BOLD) لیکل شوي فعل د ضد سره بشپړې کړئ. په بکس کې کلمې وکاروئ. ډاډ ترلاسه کړئ چې د هر فعل سمه بڼه کاروئ. لومړی یې تاسو ته حل شوی.

paras.text: 1. Although we missed our train to the airport, we still managed to catch our plane.
paras.urdu: 1. اگرچہ ہماری ایئرپورٹ جانے والی ٹرین چھوٹ گئی (missed)، پھر بھی ہم اپنا جہاز پکڑنے (catch) میں کامیاب ہو گئے۔
paras.pashto: 1. که څه هم موږ هوايي ډګر ته د تګ اورګاډی له لاسه ورکړ (missed)، خو بیا هم مو خپله الوتکه ونیوله (catch).

paras.text: 2. We didn't spend much money. In fact, we managed to ________ a lot of it.
paras.urdu: 2. ہم نے زیادہ پیسہ خرچ نہیں کیا (spend)۔ درحقیقت ہم اس کا بڑا حصہ ________ میں کامیاب رہے۔
paras.pashto: 2. موږ ډېرې پیسې ونه لګولې (spend). په حقیقت کې موږ یې ډېره برخه ________ وتوانېدو.

paras.text: 3. The train arrives at the station at 4 and it ________ 10 minutes later.
paras.urdu: 3. ٹرین 4 بجے اسٹیشن پہنچتی ہے (arrives) اور 10 منٹ بعد ________۔
paras.pashto: 3. اورګاډی په 4 بجو سټېشن ته رسېږي (arrives) او 10 دقیقې وروسته ________.

paras.text: 4. After he had emptied the bottle, he ________ it with water.
paras.urdu: 4. بوتل خالی کرنے (emptied) کے بعد اس نے اسے پانی سے ________۔
paras.pashto: 4. وروسته له دې چې بوتل یې تش کړ (emptied)، هغه یې په اوبو ________.

paras.text: 5. "Can you lend me Rs.100?"-"No way! -The last time you ________ money from me, you never gave it back!"
paras.urdu: 5. ’’کیا تم مجھے 100 روپے ادھار دے سکتے ہو (lend)؟‘‘ — ’’ہرگز نہیں! پچھلی بار جب تم نے مجھ سے پیسے ________ تو کبھی واپس نہیں کیے!‘‘
paras.pashto: 5. "ایا ماته 100 روپۍ پور راکولی شې (lend)؟" — "هېڅکله نه! تېر ځل چې تا له ما پیسې ________، هېڅکله دې بېرته رانه کړې!"

paras.text: 6. The principal doesn't allow smoking at school. In fact, he ________ everything that is bad for our health.
paras.urdu: 6. پرنسپل اسکول میں تمباکو نوشی کی اجازت نہیں دیتے (allow)۔ درحقیقت وہ ہر اس چیز کو ________ ہیں جو ہماری صحت کے لیے بری ہو۔
paras.pashto: 6. پرنسپل په ښوونځي کې د سګرټ څکولو اجازه نه ورکوي (allow). په حقیقت کې هغه هر هغه شی ________ چې زموږ روغتیا ته بد دی.

paras.text: 7. Did he confess to stealing your money? -No, he ________ everything.
paras.urdu: 7. کیا اس نے تمہارے پیسے چرانے کا اعتراف کیا (confess)؟ — نہیں، اس نے ہر چیز سے ________۔
paras.pashto: 7. ایا هغه ستاسو د پیسو د غلا اعتراف وکړ (confess)؟ — نه، هغه له هر څه ________.

paras.text: 8. In summer, the sun rises at about 5 o'clock and doesn't ________ until after nine in the evening.
paras.urdu: 8. گرمیوں میں سورج تقریباً 5 بجے طلوع ہوتا ہے (rises) اور شام نو بجے کے بعد تک ________ نہیں۔
paras.pashto: 8. په اوړي کې لمر شاوخوا 5 بجې راختي (rises) او د ماښام تر نهو بجو وروسته پورې نه ________.

paras.text: 9. There are some things you can do in private that you should never do in ________.
paras.urdu: 9. کچھ کام ایسے ہیں جو آپ نجی طور پر (private) کر سکتے ہیں لیکن انہیں کبھی ________ میں نہیں کرنا چاہیے۔
paras.pashto: 9. ځینې کارونه دي چې په شخصي ډول (private) یې کولی شئ خو هېڅکله یې باید په ________ کې ونه کړئ.

paras.text: 10. He didn't pass his exam. In fact, he ________ with a very low score.
paras.urdu: 10. وہ امتحان میں پاس نہیں ہوا (pass)۔ درحقیقت وہ بہت کم نمبروں کے ساتھ ________۔
paras.pashto: 10. هغه په ازموینه کې بریالی نه شو (pass). په حقیقت کې هغه په ډېرو ټیټو نمرو ________.

paras.text: 11. Our teacher rewarded all the good students but decided to ________ all the bad ones.
paras.urdu: 11. ہمارے استاد نے تمام اچھے طلبہ کو انعام دیا (rewarded) لیکن تمام برے طلبہ کو ________ کا فیصلہ کیا۔
paras.pashto: 11. زموږ ښوونکي ټولو ښو زده کوونکو ته انعام ورکړ (rewarded) خو پرېکړه یې وکړه چې ټول بد ________.

paras.text: 12. Although I sent the letter on Monday, she didn't ________ it until Friday.
paras.urdu: 12. اگرچہ میں نے خط پیر کو بھیجا (sent)، اسے جمعہ تک ________ نہیں۔
paras.pashto: 12. که څه هم ما لیک د دوشنبې په ورځ ولېږه (sent)، هغې تر جمعې پورې ________.

paras.text: 13. At the end of the long, dim tunnel we could see a ________ shining light.
paras.urdu: 13. لمبی، دھندلی (dim) سرنگ کے آخر میں ہمیں ایک ________ چمکتی روشنی نظر آئی۔
paras.pashto: 13. د اوږدې، تیارې (dim) تونل په پای کې موږ یوه ________ ځلېدونکې رڼا ولیده.

paras.text: 14. If you are attacked on the street, there are several ways you can ________ yourself.
paras.urdu: 14. اگر سڑک پر آپ پر حملہ ہو (attacked) تو کئی طریقے ہیں جن سے آپ اپنا ________ کر سکتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: 14. که په سړک تاسو باندې برید وشي (attacked)، ګڼې لارې شته چې ځان ________.

paras.text: 15. It was only a temporary job until I could find something more ________.
paras.urdu: 15. یہ صرف ایک عارضی (temporary) ملازمت تھی جب تک مجھے کوئی زیادہ ________ چیز نہ مل جاتی۔
paras.pashto: 15. دا یوازې لنډمهاله (temporary) دنده وه تر هغه چې یو ډېر ________ شی ومومم.

paras.text: 16. The thief said he was innocent, but the judge decided he was ________.
paras.urdu: 16. چور نے کہا کہ وہ بے قصور (innocent) ہے، لیکن جج نے فیصلہ کیا کہ وہ ________ ہے۔
paras.pashto: 16. غله وویل چې بې‌ګناه (innocent) دی، خو قاضي پرېکړه وکړه چې هغه ________ دی.

sections.theory:
Writing Suggestions

White a composition on the topic" the need of the smart phone" connecting your ideas with the use of appropriate transitional devices.

Oral Communication

Step 1: The students work together in pairs. Each student writes down three ways in which he thinks that he and his partner are similar and three ways in which he thinks they are different. He does not show his partner what he has written.

Step 2: First, both students tell each other about the similarities and talk about where they were right or wrong, then they talk about the differences.

Vocabulary and Grammar

A. Consult a dictionary and write the phonetic transcription of the following words.

B. Complete these sentences with an opposite of the verb in BOLD. Use the words from the box. Make sure that you use the correct form of each verb. The first one has been done for you.

absent -borrow -bright -catch-defend -depart -deny -fail -fill -forbid -guilty -minor -permanent -public -punish -receive -save -set -voluntary -weak

1. Although we missed our train to the airport, we still managed to catch our plane.

2. We didn't spend much money. In fact, we managed to ________ a lot of it.

3. The train arrives at the station at 4 and it ________ 10 minutes later.

4. After he had emptied the bottle, he ________ it with water.

5. "Can you lend me Rs.100?"-"No way! -The last time you ________ money from me, you never gave it back!"

6. The principal doesn't allow smoking at school. In fact, he ________ everything that is bad for our health.

7. Did he confess to stealing your money? -No, he ________ everything.

8. In summer, the sun rises at about 5 o'clock and doesn't ________ until after nine in the evening.

9. There are some things you can do in private that you should never do in ________.

10. He didn't pass his exam. In fact, he ________ with a very low score.

11. Our teacher rewarded all the good students but decided to ________ all the bad ones.

12. Although I sent the letter on Monday, she didn't ________ it until Friday.

13. At the end of the long, dim tunnel we could see a ________ shining light.

14. If you are attacked on the street, there are several ways you can ________ yourself.

15. It was only a temporary job until I could find something more ________.

16. The thief said he was innocent, but the judge decided he was ________.

مرحلہ 1: طلبہ جوڑیوں میں مل کر کام کریں۔ ہر طالب علم تین ایسے پہلو لکھے جن میں اس کے خیال میں وہ اور اس کا ساتھی ایک جیسے ہیں اور تین ایسے جن میں وہ مختلف ہیں۔ وہ اپنے ساتھی کو نہیں دکھاتا کہ اس نے کیا لکھا ہے۔

sections.content:
Writing Suggestions

White a composition on the topic" the need of the smart phone" connecting your ideas with the use of appropriate transitional devices.

Oral Communication

Step 1: The students work together in pairs. Each student writes down three ways in which he thinks that he and his partner are similar and three ways in which he thinks they are different. He does not show his partner what he has written.

Step 2: First, both students tell each other about the similarities and talk about where they were right or wrong, then they talk about the differences.

Vocabulary and Grammar

A. Consult a dictionary and write the phonetic transcription of the following words.

B. Complete these sentences with an opposite of the verb in BOLD. Use the words from the box. Make sure that you use the correct form of each verb. The first one has been done for you.

absent -borrow -bright -catch-defend -depart -deny -fail -fill -forbid -guilty -minor -permanent -public -punish -receive -save -set -voluntary -weak

1. Although we missed our train to the airport, we still managed to catch our plane.

2. We didn't spend much money. In fact, we managed to ________ a lot of it.

3. The train arrives at the station at 4 and it ________ 10 minutes later.

4. After he had emptied the bottle, he ________ it with water.

5. "Can you lend me Rs.100?"-"No way! -The last time you ________ money from me, you never gave it back!"

6. The principal doesn't allow smoking at school. In fact, he ________ everything that is bad for our health.

7. Did he confess to stealing your money? -No, he ________ everything.

8. In summer, the sun rises at about 5 o'clock and doesn't ________ until after nine in the evening.

9. There are some things you can do in private that you should never do in ________.

10. He didn't pass his exam. In fact, he ________ with a very low score.

11. Our teacher rewarded all the good students but decided to ________ all the bad ones.

12. Although I sent the letter on Monday, she didn't ________ it until Friday.

13. At the end of the long, dim tunnel we could see a ________ shining light.

14. If you are attacked on the street, there are several ways you can ________ yourself.

15. It was only a temporary job until I could find something more ________.

16. The thief said he was innocent, but the judge decided he was ________.
